mapper.sql: id, question_text, normalized_question, sql_template, params_spec, tables_used, intent_tag, chart_hint, confidence, use_count, success_count, last_used_at, version, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_sql_memory WHERE sql_template = #{sqlTemplate} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_sql_memory WHERE normalized_question = #{normalizedQuestion} AND normalized_question <> '' AND status <> 'archived' ORDER BY confidence DESC, use_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_sql_memory SET use_count = use_count + 1, last_used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
